title: Moonlight 16 — Please Leave
description: Two silver coins promise a full stomach. But at the sculpture shop, Weed discovers that money is easier to count than goodwill.
script:
story 2
variable bread = false hidden
variable polite = false hidden
label opening
scene hall
ambience hall
show Hyun excited center
camera medium Hyun
I: 两枚银币在手里，我先想到的不是剑，是面包。
I: 一个面包要三个铜币，一枚银币是一百个铜币。
I: 两枚银币，能买六十六个面包，还能有一点钱。
choice count
option food "先算算能吃多久。" -> food ; bread = true
option reward "任务还没做完，先别开心。" -> reward
label food
I: 这么多面包！我终于不用每天担心吃不饱了。
goto enough
label reward
I: 钱是先给的。问题没问清楚，我还不能安心。
label enough
I: 面包虽然不好吃，却能让我吃饱。
I: 以前没有饭吃的日子，我不想再过了。
scene square
ambience wind
show Hyun happy center
camera wide
I: 我先去水池，把水壶装满水，再去雕刻店。
activity Hyun walk right steady
I: 这是我第一次好好看看这个城市。路上全都是人。
I: 有人在找人一起玩，有人在说要一起去哪里。
I: 我身上还是新人的衣服，没有他们身上那些好东西。
I: 没有人多看我一眼。那也很好。
choice crowd
option water "多带一点水，不用花钱。" -> water
option quiet "不跟着他们看热闹，先找店。" -> quiet
label water
I: 水不用花钱。下次来，也要记得多带一点。
goto shopOutside
label quiet
I: 他们忙他们的。我先把自己的任务做好。
label shopOutside
activity Hyun stop
camera medium Hyun
I: 雕刻店就在这里，旁边是一家卖珠宝的店。
I: 玩游戏的人不常来，有钱的贵族却喜欢这里。
scene shop
ambience none
show Hyun neutral left
show Shopkeeper happy right
camera two Hyun Shopkeeper cut
look Hyun Shopkeeper
look Shopkeeper Hyun
sound chime
Shopkeeper [happy]: 欢迎——
camera listener Shopkeeper over 0.65
express Shopkeeper skeptical
I: 他看了看我的衣服，脸上的笑没有了。
camera two Hyun Shopkeeper cut
Shopkeeper [skeptical]: 你来这里，有什么事？
I: 店里只有我一个客人。他好像还不想让我来。
choice greeting
option respect "您忙的话，我说得短一点。" -> respect ; polite = true
option look "您现在有时间听个问题吗？" -> look
label respect
camera listener Shopkeeper over 0.5
react Hyun nod
Shopkeeper [skeptical]: 说得短，也要看是什么事。
goto question
label look
look Hyun away
Shopkeeper [skeptical]: 你先说，找我做什么？
look Hyun Shopkeeper
label question
camera two Hyun Shopkeeper cut
Hyun [curious]: 您好。我有一个问题，一直想不明白。
Shopkeeper [neutral]: 你有问题？
Hyun [neutral]: 是的。如果您能给我一点时间……
choice wait
option brief "让我问完，我就走。" -> brief
option patient "不再说了，等他的回答。" -> patient
label brief
Hyun [pleading]: 我问完这个问题就走。
goto refusal
label patient
I: 我不说话了。他也不说，眼睛却看向门口。
label refusal
camera listener Shopkeeper over 0.65
Shopkeeper [frustrated]: 我现在很忙。请你出去。
camera two Hyun Shopkeeper cut
Hyun [neutral]: 好的，那我下次再来。
Shopkeeper [neutral]: 再见。
camera medium Hyun
I: 他连问题是什么，都不想知道。
if bread == true -> breadReturn else rewardReturn
label breadReturn
I: 六十六个面包，我算得清楚。问一个问题，怎么这么难？
goto mannerReturn
label rewardReturn
I: 我还在想做完任务的奖励。现在，问题还没有问。
label mannerReturn
if polite == true -> respectReturn else lookReturn
label respectReturn
I: 我已经好好跟他说话了。可他还是要我走。
goto ending
label lookReturn
I: 没有其他客人，他却说自己很忙。
label ending
camera wide
activity Hyun walk left slow
look Hyun away
I: 我慢慢走向门口。带着钱来的，连问题都没能留下。
end

Hyun.name: 李贤 · Lee Hyun
Hyun.provenance: Approved Hyun B and expression refinement, imagegen concept references 2026-10-14. Translated by hand into articulated SVG: angular cheeks, layered hair, family warmth and eager reward expressions. Original fictional interpretation, not official art.

Shopkeeper.name: 店主 · Sculpture shopkeeper
Shopkeeper.provenance: Original fictional sculpture-shop keeper for the personal LMS adaptation. Shared polished SVG builder, distinct round face, tidy side-part, short beard and muted sage merchant robe; not official artwork.

sources: The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Book 1, end of Chapter 2 and opening of Chapter 3, supplied fingerprinted EPUB. Bread-price calculation, filling the canteen, first city walk, sculpture-shop welcome turning cold at his clothing, polite request refused and slow retreat toward the door. Stops before the glance at the statues and flattery. Choice replies elaborate attention and delivery without changing source events.
